install.title: Install as app
install.subtitle: Works offline and launches full-screen.
install.iosHint: Open the share menu and choose “Add to Home Screen”.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Switch the app language. Your choice is saved locally.

omdb.note: Your OMDb key is stored only in this browser. When adding or editing a movie, the app can fetch title, poster and genres via the Fetch from OMDb button.
omdb.tip: Tip: Click Test OMDb to verify your key works.
omdb.msg_ok: OMDb OK — connection and key look fine.

barcode.title: Barcode scanning
barcode.hint: Test camera permission so the scanner can start directly in forms.
barcode.tip: Tip: If the test succeeds you can scan EAN, ISBN or other codes when adding movies, books, music, comics or games.
barcode.msg_ok: Camera OK — barcode scanner can be used.
barcode.msg_denied: Camera denied. Allow camera in your browser settings.

backup.title: Backup
backup.wipe_hint: Need a clean slate? You can wipe all local data.
backup.wipe_confirm: Delete all your data? (Movies, lists, links, books, book lists, games, game lists, albums, album lists, comics and comic lists will be removed. The app stays.)

feedback.title: Feedback & sharing
feedback.hint: Send optional feedback or share the app link. No data is sent automatically.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.intro: A quick guide to Cinemoria. All data is stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB). After the first load the app works offline.

getStarted.title: Get started
getStarted.movie: Movies: go to Add movie and save your first title.
getStarted.book: Books: go to Add book and fill author, ISBN etc.
getStarted.game: Games: go to Add game and set title, platform and status.
getStarted.music: Music: go to Add music and fill title, EAN etc.
getStarted.comic: Comics: go to Add comic and fill volume, issue etc.
getStarted.profile: Under Profile you’ll find Backup (export/import), theme and camera test.

barcode.title: Barcode (camera)
barcode.where: Where to scan: in forms you’ll find the field Barcode (EAN/UPC) (movies/games) and ISBN (books) with a Scan button. Press Scan — not just the field.
barcode.note: Movies & games & comics & music: the app stores EAN/UPC locally (for recognition/notes). No external lookup yet.
barcode.books: Books: when entering ISBN the app tries to fetch metadata from Open Library (title, cover, pages etc). If it fails, fields are left untouched.
barcode.perm: Camera test & permission: go to Profile → Barcode scanning → Test camera and allow camera. Best in Chrome/Edge/Android. Good light helps.
barcode.troubleshoot: Troubleshooting: if camera won’t start, close the tab and reopen, try in browser first (not PWA), and check site camera permissions.

movies.title: Movies: add & edit
steps: Fill Title, optional Year and Genres (comma separated).
Ownership: mark Owned, Digital and Wishlist.
Edition & Tech: format (UHD/Blu-ray/DVD/VHS/Digital/Other), region, video standard, barcode (EAN/UPC), release year, cut, audio variant and notes.
Press Save. Latest titles appear on the movies page.

omdb.title: Movie metadata (OMDb) — your own API key
omdb.lead: Want to autofill title/year/poster/genres from OMDb? Use your own key. It’s stored only in your browser.
steps: Get a free key at omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx (Free plan is enough).
Open Profile → Data sources & Autofill: tick Use OMDb. Paste your key, press Test OMDb — status should be “OK”.
Go to the movie form, type a title (optionally year) and click Fetch from OMDb.
omdb.note: Note: OMDb Free has daily limits. If it fails, you’ll see an error — you can always fill manually.

books.title: Books: add & edit
steps: Fill Title, Author, optional Year and Genres.
Mark Owned / Digital / Wishlist and choose Format (hardcover/paperback/ebook/audiobook/other).
Extra fields: ISBN, Language, Pages, Publisher, cover and notes.
Press Save.

games.title: Games: add & edit
steps: Fill Title, optional Year, Platform (PS5, Switch, PC …), cover and Notes (edition/DLC/where it lives).
Mark Owned, Digital and/or Wishlist.
Press Save. Latest games show under Games → Overview.

comics.title: Comics: add & edit
steps: Fill Title, Series, Volume/Issue and optional Year.
Mark Owned / Digital / Wishlist and choose Format (e.g. staple/hardcover/other).
Add cover URL and notes (variant, condition, publisher, price etc).
Press Save.

music.title: Music & albums: add & edit
steps: Fill Album title, Artist, optional Year and Genre.
Mark Owned, Digital and/or Wishlist.
Pick Format (vinyl, CD, cassette, digital, Blu-ray Audio, SACD, other) and Notes (edition, color vinyl, press/matrix, condition).
Press Save. Latest albums show under Music → Overview.

collections.title: Collections (lists)
collections.text: Create any collections for movies, books, games, music and comics (e.g. “Shelf A”, “Favorites 2025”, “To buy”). Item counts show right away. Rename or delete lists without touching contents.

searchFilter.title: Search & filters
searchFilter.movies: Free text on title, genres, location/service, year. Filter on Owned/Digital/Wishlist.
searchFilter.books: Search by title, author, language, format, ISBN, year. Same status filters as movies.
searchFilter.games: Search by title, platform, year and notes. Filter on Owned/Digital/Wishlist.
searchFilter.music: Search by album title, artist, year, genre and format. Filter on Owned/Digital/Wishlist.
searchFilter.comics: Search by title, volume, issue, year and notes. Filter on Owned/Digital/Wishlist.

backup.title: Backup & move data
backup.export: Export creates a JSON with everything (movies/books/games/music/comics and lists/links).
backup.import: Import adds content from a previous export (duplicates may occur).
backup.wipe: Wipe all removes all local data.

pwa.title: Install as app (PWA)
pwa.ios: iPhone/iPad (Safari): Share → Add to Home Screen.
pwa.desktop: Desktop: Icon in the address bar or the browser menu.

privacy.title: Privacy, performance & troubleshooting
privacy.privacy: Privacy: your data never leaves the device. No login, no server.
privacy.sync: Sync: use export/import to move between devices.
privacy.omdb: OMDb issues? Check Profile → Data sources & Autofill: enabled, key entered, and Test OMDb shows “OK”.
privacy.empty: If something looks empty: reload, clear cache, or export → wipe all → import again.
privacy.themes: Themes: switch between dark, light and sepia under Profile.

feedback.title: Feedback & sharing
feedback.text: Under Profile you’ll find Send feedback (mailto with tech info) and Copy app link.

home.hero_lead: A shelf for what you own and love — movies, books and games. Fast and offline.
home.get_started_hint: Jump to a section. Add new, search or build collections.
home.empty_hint: Start where it’s most fun. You can always import a JSON backup via Profile.
